latestVersion.changelog:
ai-clipping v1.0.6

- Added support for AI-generated attention-grabbing text hooks in exported clips with new flags: --ai-hook, --ai-hook-style, and --ai-hook-pos.
- Updated recommended workflow to use --export and --ai-hook by default for more engaging clip outputs.
- Expanded export resolution options to support QHD_2K and UHD_4K in addition to existing resolutions.
- Updated caption style template default for --caption-display=both (now uses temp-static-2); for other modes, now defaults to word-focus.
- Documentation improvements to reflect new options and defaults.
